none: PAS CAM-27A2A4: Roman Coin : A copper-alloy radiate of Claudius II
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ ANNONA AVG ; D/ IMP C CL[AVDIV]S AVG

A copper-alloy radiate of Claudius II. AD268-270, (Reece period 13). Reverse legend reads ANNONA AVG. Reverse shows Annona left. Mint is Rome. See Cunetio, p.135, no.2044 passim. Obverse shows Radiate, cuirassed bust right. Obverse legend reads IMP C CL[AVDIV]S AVG. Die axis is probably 6 o'clock, weight is 2.3g, diameter is 21mm
